context.purpose: Evaluate temperature, heat loss and heater temperature through solid material layers with fixed temperature, prescribed outward heat flux or convection ends. Independent conservation checks and optional sampled limits gate publication.
context.assumptions: Serial Elmer HeatSolver from stable 26.2.1 source; upstream binary identifies as 26.2. Constant-area, one-dimensional solid conduction; isotropic constant conductivity, uniform generation and perfect contact. SI metres, kelvin, W/(m K), W/m3, W/m2 and W/(m2 K).
context.constraints: One to sixteen unique layers, at most 512 linear elements; stiffness contrast at most 1e8. At least one fixed-temperature or convection end anchors temperature. No CFD/fluid flow, scripts, imported decks/meshes, 2D/3D, transient, nonlinear/radiative/coupled physics or MPI. Limits cover mesh-node temperatures and element-midpoint Fourier flux; continuum extrema and mesh convergence are not certified. Adjacent mesh coordinates must remain distinct after the native eight-significant-digit VTU export.
context.inspection: temperature.csv contains every mesh-node temperature; heat-flux.csv contains derived +x element-midpoint Fourier flux and layer index. thermal-summary.json retains source-corrected outward end flux, total heat rates, conservation residual, exact-solution discrepancies and literal bound margins. Keep mesh/native_t0001.vtu, mesh/thermal.result, generated model.sif, mesh and logs for interpretation and restart provenance.
context.recovery: UNANCHORED_FIELD needs at least one value or convection end. INVALID_BOUNDARY needs value alone for value/flux, coefficient plus ambient for convection. INVALID_TEMPERATURE requires nonnegative continuum kelvin, including between-node extrema. ILL_CONDITIONED_FIELD needs smaller stiffness contrast; RESOURCE_LIMIT needs fewer cells or bounded scales. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND needs an absolute configured ElmerSolver. PERFORMANCE_NOT_MET means verified physics exceeded a literal sampled bound: inspect margins and revise design or bounds, then use a fresh directory. VERIFICATION_FAILED needs original untampered complete native evidence or a fresh execution; retain logs. EXPORT_PRECISION_LOSS needs geometry rescaling or fewer cells. RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE needs a complete installation and dependency review from version logs; NATIVE_EXECUTION_FAILED needs solve/reopen log review. These are distinct from a missing executable and unsupported runtime family.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers runtime observation, HeatSolver and fresh-process restart, plus final verification; native commands use shared owned process-tree runner.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared cancellation terminates owned native processes and checks cancellation again before success publication.
lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/effective plans, generated SIF/mesh, version/solve/reopen stdout/stderr/submissions, ASCII restart, native/reopened VTU, published tables, hashes and explicit failed result.
lifecycle.verification: Independent piecewise-quadratic transfer equations check all native nodal temperatures and derived midpoint Fourier flux. Source corrections check all element/interface and global outflow balances. A fresh Elmer process reloads ASCII restart with HeatSolver Exec Solver Never and exports a second VTU. Independent ASCII restart and XML VTU readers cross-check membership, mesh and temperature. Digests, authored/plan agreement, deterministic inputs and sampled limits are recomputed offline. Native ASCII VTU has eight significant digits; full-precision published temperature and all physical checks use ASCII restart, while exported/reopened VTU is checked against that explicit rounding.

cases.scope: Fourier q=k*(400-300)/0.2=5000 W/m2; area one m2.
Halving conductivity halves constant-area heat loss.
Series resistance 0.1/10+0.1/1=.11 m2 K/W gives 100/.11 W.
Uniform Q=100 W/m3, L=1 m, k=1 and two 300 K ends: peak 300+QL²/(8k)=312.5 K.
Outward flux left -1000 W/m2 means +x heating; right T=300+1000/100=310 K and left 320 K.
Two films 1/100 plus slab .2/10 total .04 m2 K/W; 100/.04=2500 W.
Prescribed left outward flux -1000 W/m2 and right 300 K gives left320K by Fourier law; verifies left natural-load sign.
Right outward flux1000 W/m2 and left ambient 400 K/film 100 gives left 390 K, right370K; verifies right natural-load and left film signs.
